x-card.description: MySQL 8 and MariaDB. Read queries, schema, EXPLAIN.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Where the core reaches the database. It connects from this machine, so your VPN and hosts file apply.

database.title: Database
database.description: The default database. Empty: none; qualify tables with their database.

databases.title: Databases
databases.description: Only these databases are available through this connection.

sslMode.title: SSL mode
x-enumTitles: Verify the CA and host name (verify-full)
sslMode.description: Auto uses SSL when the server supports it, otherwise connects without encryption. Use verify-full to verify the certificate and host name.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: For a private CA with verify-ca or verify-full. Empty: the system trust store.

user.title: User
user.description: Use a user that can only read wherever you can. The test below shows what it may do.

password.title: Password
password.description: Leave empty when the server permits this user to connect without a password.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: CA certificate, timeouts, pool and schema allowlist. Policies can tighten limits per environment.

statementTimeoutMs.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeoutMs.description: The database cancels slower statements. Empty: the environment policy.

allowedFunctions.title: Functions reads may call
allowedFunctions.description: Your own functions that only read, as name or database.name. Reads may call built-in functions; any other one waits for approval, and on prod it is refused.

allowPublicKeyRetrieval.title: Allow public key retrieval
allowPublicKeyRetrieval.description: Lets a fake server capture the password; prefer TLS. Needed without TLS for caching_sha2_password users.
